issues.description: Class attribute type mismatch in class GroverLightsOutPuzzle: in the template (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) the field self.number_of_bits_classical_register is assigned the string "0" (line 14). In the solution (solution_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) the same field is an integer 4 (line 14). The QuantumCircuit construction later in the template passes this attribute to ClassicalRegister(self.number_of_bits_classical_register) (template line 24), which expects an integer — the string value will raise a TypeError at runtime and confuse students when they try to run or build the circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template placeholder to an integer so it matches the expected type. For example set self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 0 (or the intended number of classical bits, e.g. 4) and update the inline comment to instruct students to replace with the correct integer number of bits. This preserves the pedagogical intent while avoiding a runtime TypeError when constructing ClassicalRegister.
